entries.title: Proverbs 29:1
segments: A man who hardens [his] neck [when] reproved shall be suddenly broken, and there will be no healing.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:2
segments: When the righteous increase, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people mourn.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:3
segments: Whoever loves wisdom rejoices his father; but a companion of harlots wastes wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:4
segments: The king establishes the land by judgment; but he [taking] bribes tears it down.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:5
segments: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:6
segments: In the sin of an evil man [there is] a snare; but the righteous sings and rejoices.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:7
segments: The righteous knows the plea of the poor; the wicked cares not to know it.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:8
segments: Scornful men bring a city into a snare, but the wise turn away wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:9
segments: [If] a wise man contends with a foolish man, whether he rages or laughs, [there is] no rest.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:10
segments: Men of blood hate the upright; but the just seek his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:11
segments: A fool speaks all his mind; but a wise one keeps it in until afterwards.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:12
segments: If a ruler listens to lies, all his servants [are] wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:13
segments: The poor and the deceitful man meet together; the LORD gives light to the eyes of both.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:14
segments: A king who truly judges the weak, his throne shall be established forever.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:15
segments: The rod and rebuke give wisdom, but a boy sent off causes shame to his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:16
segments: When the wicked are multiplied, sin increases; but the righteous shall see their fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:17
segments: Correct your son, and he shall give you rest; yea, he shall give delight to your soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:18
segments: Where [there is] no wisdom, the people perish; but he who keeps the law, he [is] blessed.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:19
segments: A servant will not be corrected by words, for though he understands, he will not answer.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:20
segments: Do you see a man hasty in his words? [There is] more hope for a fool than for him.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:21
segments: He pampering his servant from youth, [that one] in his after days shall [his] successor.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:22
segments: An angry man stirs up fighting, and a furious man abounds in sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:23
segments: A man's pride shall bring him low; but honor shall uphold the humble in spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:24
segments: He who shares with a thief hates his own soul; he hears an oath and does not tell.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:25
segments: The fear of man brings a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD shall be safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:26
segments: Many seek the ruler's favor; but each man's judgment [comes] from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:27
segments: An unjust man [is] a hateful thing to the just; and [he who is] upright in the way [is] hateful to the wicked.
